# Custom Block

The shared Remark parser supports **any** `::: type Title` directive. Each type is passed to the semantic `CustomBlock` renderer; themes and renderers are controlled by the consuming application rather than hardcoded in Markdown.

## Installation

```sh
npx @moyarich/moyaforge-cli@latest add custom-block
```

## Usage

Use the `::: type Title` Markdown directive. The Remark parser maps the directive to the semantic `CustomBlock` renderer.

## Styling

The public CSS variables `--mf-custom-block-bg`, `--mf-custom-block-border`, `--mf-custom-block-radius`, and `--mf-custom-block-padding` support theme customization. Shared `--mf-color-surface` and `--mf-color-border` tokens supply fallback values.

```css
.custom-block.experimental {
  --mf-custom-block-bg: var(--my-surface);
  --mf-custom-block-border: var(--my-accent);
}
```

The playground registers `CustomBlock` with `MDXProvider`. Consumers can replace it using the provider's `components` mapping without recompiling the document. Unknown directive types continue working without additional parser registration.

For interactive code tabs, see [Code Group](/ui/components/code-group).
